_source: RunPod REST v2 OpenAPI document (https://api.runpod.io/v2/openapi.json), components.schemas.CreateClusterRequest (allOf BaseContainerConfig + the cluster-specific object) and components.schemas.ClusterCompute, read 2026-09-14. `CreateClusterRequest` is `unevaluatedProperties: false` -- a request body may use ONLY these top-level keys, and `_rp_cluster_payload` (ci/scripts/runpod_lib.sh) is asserted against this exact set by ci/scripts/test_runpod_cluster_lib.sh so a future OpenAPI drift is caught here rather than live.
